subject: Vangate customer spotlight — quote signoff & embargo timing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Weber <anna.weber@vangatehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing

Hi Anna —

Quick follow from our product team: we’d love to feature Vangate in a short customer spotlight tied to next week’s product launch. Would you be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence quote we can include in the announcement?

Proposed timing: Redwood is planning a coordinated press release the week of Dec 6. To make that work we need a customer-approved quote and embargo timing by end-of-day Dec 2. If that’s tight, tell me what works for you and we’ll adjust.

Suggested quote (feel free to edit): "Vangate has reduced inference latency on critical workflows by 40% since moving to Redwood Dedicated, enabling faster clinician turnaround and better patient outcomes."

I’ve attached a short PR brief and a draft headline to make review fast. If you’re comfortable, please return a version you’re happy to have published and confirm an embargo window.

Thanks so much — really appreciate the partnership here.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment: PR-brief-vangate-2026-12-03.docx (docx)]

From: Anna Weber <anna.weber@vangatehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: press@magnolia-pr.com
Date: 2026-11-30T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. Happy to participate. Below is the quote we’re comfortable with (legal reviewed on our side):

"Working with Redwood’s Dedicated offering cut inference times for our triage models by roughly 40%, which directly improved clinician throughput and reduced time-to-decision for priority cases."

Embargo: we prefer the announcement to go live 2026-12-03 at 08:00 ET (12:00 UTC). That gives our comms team enough runway to prep.

I’ve attached the signed quote confirmation PDF. Please let me know if PR needs any wording tweaks.

Best,
Anna
Anna Weber
Head of Partnerships, Vangate Health
anna.weber@vangatehealth.com

[Attachment: vangate-quote-approved.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Anna Weber <anna.weber@vangatehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: press@magnolia-pr.com

Marissa / Stephanie — see Anna’s note and attached approved quote. She’s requested an embargo for 2026-12-03 08:00 ET.

Can PR ops confirm we can hit that window? Two asks:
- Quick pass on the quote wording (Anna said legal has reviewed, but please confirm it reads cleanly in the release).
- Confirm distribution list (Magnolia will handle outreach; do we want TechPress and 3-4 targeted trade pubs only?)

If PR needs changes, I’ll loop Anna back for final signoff. If everything looks good I’ll add the approved PDF to the release package and confirm the embargo in the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — Karthik

[Attachment: vangate-quote-approved.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Magnolia PR <press@magnolia-pr.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing

Thanks Karthik — quick editorial pass from PR ops below. I made a very small tweak to the quote so it fits our headline flow (see suggested text). Anna, if you’re comfortable with this we’ll publish: 

Suggested publish quote: "Working with Redwood Dedicated cut inference times for our triage models by ~40%, helping our clinical teams make faster, higher-confidence decisions."

Notes:
- Embargo window looks good to us: 2026-12-03 08:00 ET (12:00 UTC).
- Distribution: Magnolia will lead outreach to TechPress, HealthTech Monthly, and three targeted regional outlets; we won’t push to general newswire.
- Legal checklist: we just need a one-line data retention blurb from Vangate for the release. Anna — can you confirm the following sentence is okay to include? 
"Vangate retains model logs for up to 30 days for operational monitoring; no patient-identifiable data is published."

If Anna signs off on the quote + retention line, we’ll bundle the approved PDF and PR brief and schedule the embargo in HubSpot (I’ll add the link here).

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, PR & Customer Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: PR-brief-vangate-2026-12-03.docx (docx)]

From: Anna Weber <anna.weber@vangatehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Magnolia PR <press@magnolia-pr.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer case: Vangate PR/quote & embargo timing

Marissa — thanks for the edit, that wording is fine with us. The data retention line is also accurate and you have permission to include it. Final confirmation below:

Quote: "Working with Redwood Dedicated cut inference times for our triage models by ~40%, helping our clinical teams make faster, higher-confidence decisions."

Retention blurb: "Vangate retains model logs for up to 30 days for operational monitoring; no patient-identifiable data is published."

Embargo: confirmed — 2026-12-03 08:00 ET (12:00 UTC).

I’ve attached the signed PDF again for your package. Please confirm once the HubSpot embargo is set and when the press list is finalized.

Best,
Anna
Anna Weber
Head of Partnerships, Vangate Health
anna.weber@vangatehealth.com
